context.content_translation:
作为扩大海外业务的一部分，Aneliya Innovations 将其网站翻译成多种语言。
A. push
B. probe
C. raise
D. debate

items.question: As part of a ---- to expand business abroad, Aneliya Innovations translated its Web site into multiple languages.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“push”代入题干后为“As part of a push to expand business abroad, Aneliya Innovations translated its Web site into multiple languages.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（push）。
